## CroutonI18nInput

Per-locale input for translatable fields

File: `app/components/Input.vue`

| Prop | Type | Default | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `modelValue` | `TranslationsValue` | - | yes |  |
| `fields` | `string[]` | - | yes |  |
| `label` | `string` | - | no |  |
| `error` | `string \| boolean` | - | no |  |
| `defaultValues` | `Record<string, string>` | - | no |  |
| `fieldComponents` | `Record<string, string>` | - | no |  |
| `showAiTranslate` | `boolean` | - | no |  |
| `fieldType` | `string` | - | no |  |
| `collab` | `CollabConnection` | - | no | Collab connection for real-time block editing. When provided with block editor fields, content syncs via Yjs. |
| `layout` | `"tabs" \| "side-by-side"` | - | no | Layout mode: "tabs" (default) or "side-by-side". Side-by-side shows two locale columns for easy comparison. |
| `primaryLocale` | `string` | - | no | Primary locale for side-by-side layout (left column, fixed). Default: 'en' |
| `secondaryLocale` | `string` | - | no | Secondary locale for side-by-side layout (right column). If not set, shows a dropdown to select. |
| `fieldOptions` | `Record<string, FieldOptions>` | - | no | Field-specific options like transforms. E.g., { slug: { transform: 'slug' } } |
| `fieldGroups` | `Record<string, string>` | - | no | Group fields into collapsible sections. Maps field name → group label. E.g., { title: 'Info', slug: 'Info', content: 'Content', seoTitle: 'Extra', seoDescription: 'Extra' } Groups containing block editors expand to fill available height. |
| `defaultOpenGroups` | `string[]` | - | no | Which groups start open. Defaults to all groups open. Only relevant when fieldGroups is set. |
| `bareFields` | `string[]` | - | no | Fields rendered WITHOUT their auto label/translate row — for a document-style presentation where the field carries its own affordance (e.g. a big borderless title). Opt-in; default keeps the labelled rows. (#722) |
| `fieldUi` | `Record<string, { variant?: string \| undefined; size?: string \| undefined; class?: string \| undefined; }>` | - | no | Per-field overrides for the default `UInput` (variant / size / extra class), e.g. a borderless large title or a faint slug. Opt-in; only affects the plain-input branch (block/editor/textarea fields are unaffected). (#722) |
| `fieldPlaceholders` | `Record<string, string>` | - | no | Per-field placeholder text (e.g. a borderless title's "Untitled page"). Takes priority over the derived fallback-locale placeholder. Opt-in. (#722) |
| `activeLocale` | `string` | - | no | Externally-controlled editing locale (tabs layout). When set, this input edits that single locale and follows the value — so several inputs can be driven by ONE shared language selector (the pages editor's language bar). |
| `hideLocaleSwitcher` | `boolean` | - | no | Hide the built-in locale switcher (the per-input EN/NL/FR strip). Pair with `activeLocale` + an external selector so the switching lives in one place. |
